title_en: SHRINK: a game inside real microscope slides
title_zh: 变小探险：钻进真正的显微镜玻片里
description_en: Shrink into {{v:shrink.used}} real microscope slides, from a bee's wing hooks to a cell splitting in two. A free zoom game for curious kids: find the postcards by getting to the right place and the right size.
description_zh: 钻进 {{v:shrink.used}} 张真正的显微镜玻片：从蜜蜂翅膀上的小钩子，到正在一分为二的细胞。给好奇孩子的免费缩放游戏：既要找对地方，又要缩到对的大小，才能找到明信片。
